tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun blo gsal rgya mtsho'i mgur 'bum gyi tshogs lam bzang gsal ba'i 'od snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru we/ dpal rgyal ba sras bcas skyed pa'i yab/ /rigs kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /bod mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /mi kho bo'i 'dren mchog bka' drin can/ /rje rgyal ba sku dngos rdo rings pa/ /dpal kun spangs chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gzhi ma dag 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'di/ /lam nyams kyi snang ba 'khyer shes na/ /don dag pa'i rang zhal rjen par mthong / /de dbyer med blang dor gyi mdud pa grol/ /rje snang ba lam ston gyi rdo rings pa/ /lam snang gsum rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gdangs 'gag med 'khor ba'i 'char sgo 'di/ /gshis myang 'das stong pa'i dbyings su dengs/ /don med bzhin snang ba'i rol rtsed mkhan/ /de zung 'jug blo 'das bsam brjod bral/ /rje gnas lugs ngo sprod kyi rdo rings pa/ /sems rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /lus rdo rje rtsa yi dkyil 'khor la/ /gzhi smin byed bum pa'i dbang bskur nas/ /lam snang stong lha yi 'khor lo mchog /don rang bzhin lhan skyes ston mdzad pa'i/ /rje sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i rdo rings pa/ /lam bskyed rim 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngag dag pa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gzhi zab mo gsang ba'i dbang bskur nas/ /lam gsal stong bdag byin brlabs pa yis/ /don rang rig lhan skyes ston mdzad pa'i/ /rje rang byung ston pa'i rdo rings pa/ /lam rtsa rlung 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /khams dwangs ma'i bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gzhi shes rab ye shes dbang bskur nas/ /lam bde stong dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yis/ /don zhu bde lhan skyes ston mdzad pa'i/ /rje lhan skyes ston pa'i rdo rings pa/ /lam pho nya bsgrod par byin gyis rlobs/

/rlung snying po ye shes dkyil 'khor la/ /gzhi mchog dbang bzhi pa'i dbang bskur nas/ /lam bde mchog rba rlabs rnam gsum gyi/ /don rnam kun mchog ldan ngo sprod mkhan/ /rje rnam dag ston pa'i rdo rings pa/ /lam phyag chen bsgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /khams 'dus pa gsum gyi 'phrang chen la/ /lam spyod pa gsum gyi gdams ngag gis/ /sems re dogs 'ching ba rang sar grol/ /gegs bar chad bya ba rdzun du sangs/ /rje snyan brgyud kyi bdag po rdo rings pa/ /rkyen lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /thabs zab mo dbang bzhi'i nyams len gyis/ /rten dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi'i 'gros chen thim/ /don sku bzhi mngon gyur rdo rje 'chang / /dus tshe 'dir thob pa e ma mtshar/ /rje yang dag lam ston gyis rdo rings pa/ /sprang 'ja' lus rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag dbang po brtul zhing brtson 'grus zhan/ /don gnas lugs tshe 'dir ma thob na/ /'phrang srid pa bar do'i gnas skabs su/ /lam dran pa rnam gsum gyi gdams pa bsgom/ /rje bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi rdo rings pa/ /sems rang byung rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lam de dag gi nyams tshod 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /thabs sgyu ma rmi lam gyi gdams ngag gis/ /dus nyin mtshan gyi snang ba gcig tu bsres/ /bsgom 'khor yug gi ngang la nyams su len/ /rje sgyu ma ngo sprod kyi rdo rings pa/ /lam rmi lam 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phrang bar do nyams 'og ma tshud na/ /lam dag pa smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar nas/ /thabs zab mo 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gnas dag pa'i zhing du thogs med 'gro/ /rje lam mchog ston pa'i rdo rings pa/ /sprang zhen pa thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nga dal 'byor rdo rje'i lus mchog thob/ /pha mtshan ldan bla mas rjes su bzung / /lam tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi ldan thob/ /da gang ltar byas kyang e ma ho/ /rje bka' drin 'khor med rdo rings pa/

/dus byang chub bar du byin gyis rlobs/ /ces gsung ngag rin po che'i lam rim dang sbyar ba'i nyams dbyangs skal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i glu zhes bya ba a la la ho// ༈ //e ma ho/ kha bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs kyi/ /yul dbus sa yi thig le'i ngos/ /dben pa'i ri sul yang steng na/ /bla ma sgom pa'i ku su lu/ /khyod kyi thog ma'i skye yul gang / /dam pa'i yongs 'dzin su yis bzung / /da lta nyams len gdams ngag gang / /phyi ma'i gtad so ji lta yod/ /ces gleng ba la/ kho bo'i sems la 'di lta bu'i ngo mtshar ba bar chad dam/ dngos grub gang yin yang rung / lan drang por btab snyam nas 'di ltar smras so/ /ston dus bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas ltar/ /dkar zhing yid 'phrog chu 'dzin gseb/ /gnas pa'i 'chi med gzhon nu gnyis/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsi sgra dbyangs snyan/ /shākya'i bstan la rab byung zhing / /dam pa'i ded dpon gyis bzung yang / /snyoms las dbang gis bcings pa yi/ /ser gzugs bdag gi skyes pa'i yul/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi gtsang stod cha/ /chu bo pakṣu'i lho ngos kyi/ /grom stod sa skya'i bya 'dab ljongs/ /'brog mi lo tsā'i gnas kyi 'dabs/ /phrang gsum nang nas srid phrang gdong / /rmu rje btsad pos bzung ba'i sa/ /der ni sngon gyi las dbang gis/ /dal 'byor rin chen rnyed pa yin/ /thub bstan rin chen sgor zhugs nas/ /dam chos bdud rtsi nos pa yis/ /spyir ni yongs 'dzin bcu phrag bzhi/ /zung gnyis dag gis lhag par bzhugs/ /khyad par tshe rabs dpag med nas/ /rjes su bzung ba'i 'dren pa mchog /tshe 'dir rang sems lhan skyes 'di/ /skye med chos skur ngo sprod cing / /zab mo'i dbang bzhi'i chu bo'i rgyun/ /bum pa gang byor gnang ba yis/ /bka' drin mnyam med rdo rings pa/ /'gran zla kun dang bral ba yin/ /nyams len gdams pa'i gtso bo ni/ /rgyal yum bdag med mkha' 'gro la/

/paṇa grub dbang po bi ru pas/ /nos pa nas bzung da lta'i bar/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod du/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo ma nub pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan dbang bzhi'i lam/ /rdo rje theg pa'i snying po yin/ /yang snying zab mo bla ma'i lam/ /yengs pa med par sgom pa yin/ /phyi ma'i gang 'gro da lta med/ /sgyu ma'i skyas chen 'degs pa'i tshe/ /kho bo'i bla ma bslu med de/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar 'byon snyam yod/ /bde chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /rang sems stong pa spros bral gnyis/ /dbyer med bsres nas lhug par 'jog /gang ltar song yang 'gyod pa med/ /ces pa nam mkha'i gzhon nu'i dri ba dri lan gyi yi ge ྀatsha// ༈ //oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bka' drin 'khor thabs med do drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /snying nas bsam bzhin dran no rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po/ /snying dbus 'bral med bzhugs dang pha rgod rdo rje 'chang chen/ /skyabs mgon gzhan nas mi 'tshol thugs rjes rgyang nas gzigs shig /bsam bzhin snying rlung ldang ngo ma rgan 'khor ba'i gnas tshul/ /dal bar sdod long 'dug gam skye rga na 'chi'i khor yug /lus dang grib ltar 'brang ba dge sdig dkar nag gi las 'bras/ /bslu med skyabs gnas mthar thug drin can bla mar 'dug pa/ /'khor ba sna tshogs su shar ba ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i ltad mo/ /brtags tshe rdul phran tsam med pa stong nyid myang 'das kyi ngo bo/ /dbyer med bsam brjod dang bral ba blo 'das bde chen gyi bzhugs tshul/ /sgom med yengs med du skyong ba rnal 'byor kho bo yi lta ba/ /sbyang gzhi skye shi yi bar do sbyong byed rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor/ /gsal stong zung 'jug gi ting 'dzin zab gsal lhan skyes kyi gzugs brnyan/ /'bras bu sku gsum gyi ngo bo dbyer med ro gcig tu bsres nas/ /mnyam rjes khor yug tu skyong ba rnal 'byor kho bo yi sgom pa/

/phyi tshul nyan thos kyi spyod pas tshul khrims srog bzhin du bsrungs shing / /nang du gzhan phan gyi snying rjes 'gro kun bu bzhin du bsams nas/ /gsang ba gnyis med kyi ye shes dgag sgrub blang dor dang bral ba/ /bzo med lhug pa ru skyong ba rnal 'byor kho bo yi spyod pa/ /skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs rang don chos sku yi go 'phang / /myur bar mngon du byas nas bgrang yas gzugs sku yi bkod pa/ /gang la gang 'dul gyi rnam pas nam mkha'i mtha' klas kyi sems can/ /smin grol mchog la sbyor ba rnal 'byor kho bo yi 'bras bu/ /zhes pa lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi glu ྀatsha// ༈ //na mo gu ra we/ chu mgo gangs dkar la thug go /zung 'jug rdo rje las 'chang chen/ /brgyud pa 'khrul pa yi dri bral/ /rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras/ /bla ma mkhas grub nas gnyis 'dzoms/ /drin can rdo rings pa chen po/ /gdams ngag mkha' 'gro yi snyan brgyud/ /gsung ngag yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /nyams len phyogs re tsam ma yin/ /bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len/ /blo bde phugs su rang tshud do/ /sprang po rgyal khams kyi bya bral/ snying la rus pa gcig chug dang / /sangs rgyas lag na rang 'dug pa/ /snod ldan slob ma 'dra yod na/ /kho bo'i rjes rang la byon dang / /ces yongs rdzogs pa don ldan gyi glu ྀatsha// ༈ //na mo gu ra we/ dpal rgyal ba kun 'dus rdo rings pa/ /mi kho bo'i gtsug gi nor bu'i rtser/ /zhabs brtan par bzhugs nas dad ldan gyi/ /bu khyed kyi rgyud la byin gyis rlobs/ /sprang rgyal khams kyi bya bral rnal 'byor la/ /snying thag pas dad pa'i 'phar tshang pa/ /bu khyed la snying gtam 'di skad smras/ /snyan lhan ne gsan la nyams su longs/ /gnas khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas/ /rten dal 'byor rnyed pa da lan tsam/ /de rnyed par dka' la 'jig par sla/ /'di stong log ma byed 'phar tshang pa/ /lar 'chi ba zer ba'i sgra bo che/

/spyir nam yong gi dus btab kho la med/ /dgos tshe mjug gi nyi ma ri la 'dzegs/ /da long med kyi 'chi chos byed re ran/ /lar tshe 'di'i 'dun shom mang po dag /dus gtan du bsgrubs kyang 'grub par dka'/ /de grub kyang bskyur nas 'gro rgyu yin/ /don de la soms la lings te skyur/ /khong dpon po dang grogs mched sbyin bdag gsum/ /sems bzung bas zin pa nan tan dka'/ /de thang gcig zin kyang dgos dus bslu/ /dbang gzhan la ma bskur rang thag chod/ /gnas mi med kyi lung stong yangs po na/ /grogs 'dzer med kyi bya dang ri dwags yod/ /zas sdig med kyi sngo dang chu gtsang zhim/ /sems dal med kyi 'chi ba sgug sdod mdzod/ /rgyu las nyon gyi dbang gis bskyod pa yi/ /sems kun rdzob kyi 'char sgo ci shar yang / /don chos nyid ngang las 'das pa med/ /de gces 'dzin ma byed lhug par zhog /rje sangs rgyas zer ba'i thabs mkhas des/ /khong gdul bya'i snang ngor chos kyi sgo/ /grangs mang bar gsung kyang don gyi bcud/ /lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ /don de phyir kho bo'i spyi gtsug na/ /rje mkhas grub kyi dbang po rdo rings pa/ /khyod dad ldan gyis bltas na mthong ba tsam/ /nga skal ldan gyis bltas na mngon sum bzhugs/ /'di khams gsum sems can gyi skyabs gcig yin/ /sgos kho bo'i glo snying gtod sa yin/ /bu dad gus yod na bslu ba med/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/ /las skyid sdug legs nyes ci shar yang / /blo the tshom med par hril le gtod/ /dus 'du 'bral med pa rgyun du bsgom/ /rje bla ma'i thugs dang kho bo'i sems/ /bu khyod kyi mos pa'i gdung sems gsum/ /dbyings dag pa'i ngang nas 'du 'bral med/ /de shes par gyis la gsol ba thobs/ /tshe 'di ru mjal ba'i rten 'brel sgrig /de cis kyang 'grub par ma nus na/ /dus nam zhig dag pa'i zhing khams su/

/rje bla ma'i drung du nges par 'phrad/ /gtam de skad smras pa'i bya bral bas/ /snying brtse bas khyed la gdams pa yin/ /de brjed par ma byed thugs dkyil zhog /don 'grub par nges pas dga' spro bskyed/ /ces rgyal khams pas dad pa skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma 'phar tshang chos rje la gtams su bskur ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ shu bhaṃ// ༈ //na mo ratna gu ra we/ /smin byed dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi/ /ye shes sku bzhir byin brlabs pa'i/ /drin can bla ma rdo rings pa/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ /brtse bas thugs rje'i rgyang nas gzigs/ /ma dag snod kyi 'jig rten kun/ /ye shes snang ba'i gzhal med khang / /dag pa'i yid 'ong pho brang du/ /bde bar rgyu ba bla ma'i drin/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ /brtse bas thugs rje'i rgyang nas gzigs/ /dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba kun/ /gdod nas dag pa'i he ru ka /lha dang lha mo'i rnam rol du/ /dga' mgur spyod pa bla ma'i drin/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ /brtse bas thugs rje'i rgyang nas gzigs/ /gtum mo'i a shad rab 'bar ba/ /rlung gis bskul ba'i bde drod kyis/ /shing bal lwa ba'i gos bskyur nas/ /bde chen skyong ba bla ma'i drin/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ /brtse bas thugs rje'i rgyang nas gzigs/ /mtshan ldan kha kha mu kha yi/ /ze'u 'bru'i bcud kyis stobs rgyas te/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i them skas la/ /myur mgyogs pho nya bla ma'i drin/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ /brtse bas thugs rje'i rgyang nas gzigs/ /gang shar snang ba rang gi sems/ /gsal stong zung 'jug gdod ma'i gshis/ /smra brjod blo 'das gnyug ma'i ngang / /lhug par skyong ba bla ma'i drin/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ /brtse bas thugs rje'i rgyang nas gzigs/ /sbyang gzhi sha lnga sbyong byed kyi/

/bdud rtsi rnam lngar byas pa las/ /sbyang 'bras ye shes lnga rol bas/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bla ma'i drin/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ /brtse bas thugs rje'i rgyang nas gzigs/ /la la ba glang ji bzhin spyod/ /kha cig bram ze'i rnam par skyong / /kho bo nyan thos spyod pa mdzes/ /shugs 'byung skyong ba bla ma'i drin/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ /brtse bas thugs rje'i rgyang nas gzigs/ /de ltar drin can bla ma yi/ /bka' drin bsam na 'khor thabs med/ /lus srog longs spyod de dag kun/ /'bul lo brtse bas thugs rjes gzigs/ /ces rje btsun bla ma'i bka' drin dran pa'i nyams dbyangs ྀatsha/ /dge'o// ༈ //na mo gu ru we/ rje bka' drin 'khor med kha'u pa/ /pha kun spangs chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /khyed dad ldan slob ma'i bskul ba'i ngor/ /sprang kho bo'i rtogs brjod tshig 'ga' smra/ /nga sngon chad dge ba'i 'phen shugs kyis/ /rten dal 'byor rdo rje'i lus mchog thob/ /rje mtshan ldan bla mas rjes su bzung / /chos rdo rje theg pa'i yang snying thob/ /gnas ri khrod dben pa'i bas mtha' bsten/ /lam rim pa gnyis la 'bad rtsol byas/ /nyams ban bun gyis snang ba ci yang shar/ /de sngon 'byung ba yi gleng gzhi yin/ /dus deng sang gi gnas tshul bshad tsa na/ /gdon chos brgyad kyi 'byung pos snying la btab/ /zas dkor zas kyi dug chus ci yang myos/ /sems snyoms las kyi mal nas lang dus med/ /don snang chung gi khe nyen brtsi brtsi nas/ /dgra 'chi bdag gis sbar zin byas kyi dogs/ /nga bsam bzhin du snying khong chu bas grang / /de da lta'i rnam thar lhug pa yin/ /da tshe gzhug la re smon 'di ltar yod/ /don tshe 'di yi re ltos lings te bskyur/ /khong mgo nag mi yi khyu nas bud/ /gnas nges med kyi ri khrod stong pa ru/ /zas zhen med kyi rtswa dang ldum bu'i zas/ /lam 'khrul med kyi rim gnyis rnal 'byor la/

/sems rtse gcig tu yengs med lhug par 'jog /rkyen gang shar gyi snang ba lam du 'khyer/ /dus 'chi ba nam yong gi sgug sdod byed/ /rje bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs de la byed/ /ma khams gsum 'gro ba'i drin lan 'jal/ /khyed dad ldan slob ma'i dkor sbyong yin/ /de thugs la zhog cig slob bu rnams/ /sems de la 'gro na ji bzhin mdzod/ /sprang re smon 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rgyal khams pa rang gi tshe 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi rtogs brjod sems la shar ba sgro skur med par lhug par smras pa dge'o// ༈ //swasti/ lha shākya mu nes lung bstan pa/ /yul gtsang stod sa yi thig le mchog /bod chen po'i yul du phyin kyang rung / /mi chu rdo can gyi rgyal khams spongs/ /gnas 'dar stod grom pa sa skya ru/ /yul bdag bzung med pa'i bya btang gis/ /dus da lta'i skye bo gdul bar dka'/ /don de phyir zab mo'i sgrub la dril/ /dpal bde mchog 'khor lo rnal 'byor la/ /lha dgyes pa rdo rje rim bzhin du/ /khyod byang chub sgrub pa'i yi dam gyis/ /dpal ga na pa ti rigs byed ma/ /nor sbyin pa'i ngal gso dmar po dang / /shrī kā ma rā dza rim bzhin du/ /yul khams gsum dbang byed lha ru zungs/ /stag smyon pa gzhon dang rta nag can/ /dpal ma he'i zhal can gshin rje gshed/ /chos srung ba'i gtso bo gur zhal gnyis/ /de rim bzhin bsgrubs la bstan pa srungs/ /rlung zab mo sngags kyi rang gdangs dang / /lha sgrol dkar tshe dpag med mgon gyis/ /tshe sring zhing mgon dkar dbang po yis/ /nor 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor stsol bar 'gyur/ /de tsittar chongs la lag tu longs// ༈ //na mo gu ru we/ bka' drin 'khor med rje btsun kha'u pa/ /snying nas 'dud do gtsug gi rgyan du bzhugs/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i rten 'brel ltad mo'i glu/ /brag stong nyams dbyangs thal lo bla ma rje/ /thugs rjes rgyang nas gzigs dang drin can rdo rings pa/

/snying nas 'du 'bral med do pha rgod rdo rje 'chang / /spang gshongs sgom thun byed pa'i lha bya gong mo tsho/ /gshog 'gyur gsung snyan sgrog pa snang ba bde/ /nyi zer la la bzhud pa ma tshor ram/ /rang yul tshang sgo snyeg pa mi drag gam/ /don med wa khyis bzung na mi 'gyod dam/ /bsam mno legs po thongs dang lha bya gong mo tsho/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thongs dang spu sdug gsung snyan tsho/ /na mnyam sems mthun bsdebs pa'i gzhon nu tsho/ /glu dbyangs rtsed 'jo byed pa snang ba bde/ /grib so thang la babs pa ma tshor ram/ /shing thun rem nas sgrugs pa mi drag gam/ /drin can a mas 'thab na mi 'gyod dam/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thongs dang a ma'i gces phrug tsho/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thongs dang na mnyam yid 'ong tsho/ /ri khrod dben par gnas pa'i bya bral ba/ /bag yangs gcer nyal byed pa snang ba bde/ /'chi bdag bdud po 'ong ba ma shes sam/ /rtse gcig bsam gtan bsgom pa mi drag gam/ /dal 'byor stong log byas na mi 'gyod dam/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thongs dang rnal 'byor bya bral ba/ /bsam mno legs po thongs dang ri khrod sgom chen pa/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /mkhas grub mtshan ldan bla mas rjes su bzung / /gdams ngag rgyud sde zab mo'i yang snying thob/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas byas pa mi drag gam/ /blo bskyed sha ma gcig thon dang drin can bla ma'i sras/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thongs dang rgyal khams bya bral ba/ /zhes pa 'di ni 'phan yul bya bzang gi ri khrod kyi brag kha zhig tu/ nyi ma dgongs phyogs skyo bsangs byas pa'i tshe/ mdun gyi spang gshongs la gong mo mang po rtse zhing / rgyab kyi thang la phyugs rdzi mang po shing 'thu zhing rtsed mo byed pa mthong bas/ 'di dag kyang bsams na dge sbyor gyi bskul mar 'dug snyam nas rang sems la gsal 'debs su smras pa'o//

shu bhaṃ// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ pha drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /khyed nor bu'i mtshan can snyan gson cig /bu khyed la snying gtam 'di skad smra/ /'di dad pas rtse gcig nyams su longs/ /tshe 'di snang 'char sgo ji snyed pa/ /'di mdang gsum nyal ba'i rmi lam 'dra/ /de don la grub pa gcig kyang med/ /'di spros med kyi ngang la bskur las zhog /rang mos pa'i drin can bla ma de/ /sku rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can/ /zhal 'dzum zhing dgesad pa'i nyams dang bcas/ /mdun nam mkha'i dbyings su lam gyis bsgom/ /tshe thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /yul 'khor bar 'khyams pa sdig pa'i tshogs/ /las ji snyed bsags pa snying nas bshags/ /de dag go snyam pa'i dga' spro bskyed/ /rang dbang ba'i lus dang longs spyod kun/ /rje bla ma de la ling gis phul/ /da gang la'ang chags zhen med pa yi/ /gnas dag pa'i zhing du 'gro snyam mdzod/ /lus lte ba nas bzung spyi bo'i bar/ /rtsa dbu ma dkar gsal sba lcag tsam/ /nang yangs shing steng sgo gsal le ba'i/ /mthil de ru rang sems 'od dkar po/ /tshad sran chung tsam zhig gsal bar bsgom/ /rje spyi bo'i bla ma dam pa la/ /snying dad pa'i gsol ba 'di ltar thobs/ /rje sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang / /bdag dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid du gsol/ /ces lan grangs bdun nam nyer gcig brjod/ de brjod pa'i mod la bla ma de'i/ /thugs brtse ba'i 'od zer dkar po gcig /rtse lcags kyu'i rnam pa ba thag ltar/ /rtsa dbu ma'i nang du thal gyis zhugs/ /sems 'od phung de la reg ma thag /de rtsen gyis blangs nas rgyang gis thon/ /pha bla ma'i thugs kar sib kyis thim/ /thugs bde chen ngang du dbyer med bsres/ /de spros bral gyis ngang du cham gyis zhog /'di ma brjed yang dang yang du bsgom/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs kyi bcud/ /dus 'da' ka'i man ngag khyad par can/ /bu khrod la brtse bas gdams pa yin/

/'di rtse gcig bsgom na bslu ba med/ /ces chos rje nor bu la bandhe blo gsal gyis snying nas gdams pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// ༈ //shrī mā na gu ru sa dā ya na maḥ bla ma dran pa'i gdungs dbyangs snying gi padmo g.yo ba'i dri gzhon bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la snying nas skyabs su mchi'o/ /e ma yul dbus sman ljongs kyi/ /dben pa bya bzang ri bo'i rtser/ /rnal 'byor sprang po ku sā li/ /sems kyi skyo ba bsangs pa'i tshe/ /pha bla ma dran pa'i bskul ma byung / /nub mig sman ri bo'i rtse mo nas/ /chu 'dzin ston zla'i mdog can la/ /'ja' tshon gsar pa'i lding gur phub/ /de brtags tshe grom stod kha'u ngos/ /rje bla ma dran pa'i gsal 'debs byas/ /nga bsam zhing sgom zhing bla ma dran/ /pha mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /sprang bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ /gnas gtsang stod sa yi thig le na/ /dpal ya mtshan kha'u'i brag gi rdzong / /khong tsa tur mu kha'i pho brang na/ /bod mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /rje rnal 'byor dbang po rdo rings pa/ /dus da lta bzhugs na nga re dga'/ /nga bsam zhing bsgom zhing bla ma dran/ /rje gdan gsum tshang ba'i he ru kas/ /gzhi smin byed dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /las skal bar ldan pa'i slob bu rnams/ /dbyings ye shes chen po'i ngang nyid du/ /rgyud sku bzhi'i sa bon rnam dag 'debs/ /dus da lta bskur na nga rang dga'/ /nga bsam bzhin bsgom bzhin bla ma dran/ /rje rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kyi bcud/ /ma bdag med mkha' 'gros birwar gdams/ /dus de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ /khong sangs rgyas rgyud sde'i ye shes kyis/ /rgyud smin pa grol byed lam gyi dbang / /dus da lta thob na nga re dga'/ /nga bsam zhing bsgom zhing bla ma dran/ /dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po'i snying po'i don/ /khong rgya bod paṇa grub bgrod pa'i lam/

/pha mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung gi bcud/ /de bsgoms pa tsam gyis ye shes 'char/ /chos tshad ma bzhi ldan gsung ngag de/ /dus da lta gnang na dga'ūū+ū ba la/ /rje mtshan ldan padma'i dri bsung la/ /phyogs kun nas 'dus pa'i mkhas grub kyi/ /lung rig pa nyams myong rtogs pa'i mdzod/ /mi chen po dad can ku sā li/ /khong dag snang 'byongs pa'i rdo rje'i spun/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /mi phal cher so skye'i bla ma bsten/ /nga sangs rgyas dngos kyi bla ma bsten/ /khong dpe nag bltas pa'i slob mas khengs/ /nga snyan brgyud zab mo'i gdams pas tshim/ /gzhan tshig tsam thos pas snying nas yus/ /nga nyams su myong na dga' ba la/ /da ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rje bla ma khyed rang ma gtogs pa/ /sprang bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ /pha bla ma'i bka' drin bsam tsa na/ /lus ba spu g.yo zhing mchi ma 'khrug /dus gtan du zhabs drung skye bar shog /nga bsam zhing bsgom zhing bla ma dran/ /pha mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /sprang bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ /ces yul dbus bde chen lhun grub kyi ri bo'i rtse nas bla ma dran pa'i gdungs dbyangs thogs med du blangs pa'o// ༈ //na mo gu ra we/ ma lus rgyal ba yi ngo bo/ /gdan gsum tshang ba yi ded dpon/ /sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi chos rjes/ /sprang po'i rtsa ba yi bla ma/ /drin can rdo rings pa chen po'i/ /zhabs la snying nas rang 'dud do/ /pad dkar bzhad pa yi rtse la/ /bung ba lding ba 'di ngo mtshar/ /dri gzhon rgyas pa yi bser bus/ /bas mthar bskyod pa 'di sems skyo/ /sbrang rtsi gsar pa yi bcud la/ /yang yang 'khor ba 'di dga' 'o/ /lho phyogs 'dzam gling gi thig le/ /'od stong shar ba 'di ngo mtshar/ /gling bzhi bskor ba yi dbang gis/ /myur bar bzhud pa 'di sems skyo/ /rta bdun shing rta yi 'gros kyi/ /sang nyin 'char ba 'di dga' 'o/ /pad mtsho rgyas pa yi ngos su/

/ngang mo 'bab pa 'di ngo mtshar/ /byis pa'i skye bo yi rtsed pa'i/ /yud kyis 'phur ba 'di sems skyo/ /nor 'dzin mthon po yi spo nas/ /bsam zhing 'khor ba 'di dga' 'o/ /rang sems gnyug ma yi gnas tshul/ /rang bzhin chos sku 'di ngo mtshar/ /bden 'dzin a 'thas su bzung bas/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'di sems skyo/ /rang zhal rjen pa ru mjal tshe/ /gnyis med ye shes 'di dga' 'o/ /rnal 'byor bya bral gyi mdun par/ /mched grogs 'khor ba 'di ngo mtshar/ /bla ma'i bka' nan gyi dbang gis/ /so sor 'bral ba 'di sems skyo/ /'gyur med dam bca' yi brtan pos/ /myur bar 'phrad pa 'di dga' 'o/ /de skad smra ba yi rnal 'byor/ /zung 'jug bde chen gyi ngang nas/ /skal bzang rdo rje yi spun dang / /'bral med rtse dga' yi rol bzhin/ /gnas lugs mngon gyur gyi rtsed mo/ /'gro don lhan cig tu bgyid do/ /shu bhaṃ// ༈ /na mo gu ra we/ bka' drin 'khor med kyi 'dren pa/ /sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi chos rje/ /sprang po'i rtsa ba yi bla ma/ /drin can rdo rings pa chen po/ /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /gdan gsum tshang ba yi ded dpon/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi rigs bdag /rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi gtso bo/ /sras bcas rgyal ba yi yab gcig /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /rnam dag dbang bzhi yi chu rgyun/ zab lam rgya mtsho yi 'byung gnas/ /rnam grol sku bzhi yi lam ston/ /rnam mang yon tan gyi bdag nyid/ /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi ngo bo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi rnam sprul/

/theg gsum dge 'dun gyi gtsug rgyan/ /khams gsum sems can gyi 'dren mchog /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /stobs chen 'khor ba yi dong sprugs/ /mthu chen bdud dpung gi gnyen po/ /rgya chen 'gro ba yi skyabs mgon/ /dpal chen srung ma yi ngo bo/ /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /khams gsum mun nag gi sgron me/ /snyan brgyud bstan pa yi nyin byed/ /skal ldan gdung sel gyi zla ba/ /dgos 'dod mchog stsol gyi nor bu/ /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /gcig shes kun mkhyen gyi mkhas pa/ /sdom gsum mthar phyin gyi btsun pa/ /don gnyis lhun grub kyi bzang po/ /sku bzhi mngon gyur gyi grub dbang / /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /sprang po'i las ngan gyi dbang gis/ /khams gsum 'khor ba ru 'khyams kyang / /blo sna bla ma yis phrogs pas/ /lus sems za zi yi ngang nas/ /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /dam pa'i bka' drin 'di dran tshe/ /lus srog longs spyod dang bcas pa/ /grangs med bskal pa ru btang yang / /drin la 'khor thabs rang min 'dug /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /rang sems dag pa yi snang brnyan/ drin can bla ma ru shar bas/ /brjod med bde chen gyi rang zhal/

/rtsod med lhug pa ru mthong bas/ /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /gzhi lam 'bras bu yi chos kun/ /sems nyid gcig po yi rnam sprul/ /rang sems lhan skyes kyi bla ma/ /gcig chog rgyal po ru 'dug pa/ /gsol ba snying rang nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /snang ba bla ma ru shar tshe/ /blang dor bya byed dang bral song / /spros med mos gus kyi rang gdengs/ /brjod med gsol 'debs su 'dug pa/ /gsol ba snying dkyil nas 'debs so/ /'di phyi bar do dang gsum du/ /re sa gzhan na rang med do/ /thugs rjes 'bral med du skyongs shig /ces rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs pa ni/ tho rangs kyi tshe rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po rmi lam du gsal bar byon pas rkyen byas nas yongs 'dzin dam pa de'i bka' drin rjes su dran nas/ bzod blags med pa'i mos gus gsal stong ngang nas thal byung du smras pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //swasti/ rang sems dben pa'i nags tshal la gcig tu dga' zhing spro ba'i gtam snying gi skyo ba bsangs pa'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba/ rje bla ma kun spangs chen po la snying gi dkyil nas skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag gi dgos 'dod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig kye ho/ mi bzad 'khor ba'i chu gter che/ /'jigs rung ngan 'gro'i rba rlabs g.yo ba'i klongs/ /nyes brgya'i chu srin gdug pa'i gre ba nas/ /dal 'byor yid bzhin rnyed pa da lan tsam/ /skyes tsam nyid nas 'chi ba'i phyogs su phyin/ /gshed mas khrid pa'i phyugs bzhin bzlog tu med/ /'chi ba'i rkyen mang gson pa'i rkyen ni dkon/ /chu lbur dag dang rlung nang mar me bzhin/ /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs rmi lam bde ba dang /

/snyan grags brag cha'i sgra snyan dang mtshungs shing / /'du rgod mang ba sgyu ma'i gar mkhan ltar/ /bsags pa'i longs spyod sbrang ma'i rtsi bzhin no/ /'jig rten bya ba ba tshwa'i chu 'thungs bzhin/ /ji tsam spyad kyang tshims pa'i dus med cing / /de lta'i ngang la 'chi ba glo bur bslebs/ /'gyod cing bred kyang bya ba'i thabs 'dug gam/ /snyigs dus skye bo'i spyod pas gting nas sun/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba dug ltar mthong / /mang po'i ngo bsrung blun po'i khol por shes/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni gcig pur cis mi 'dug /tshe 'di 'ba' zhig don gnyer slob ma'i dbus/ /chags sdang khong khro'i 'du 'dzis dus 'da' zhing / /gzhan smod bdag bstod chos kyi 'chad nyan la/ /kho bo snying gi dkyil nas skyo ba skye/ /rang yul nye du longs spyod kun dor nas/ /cha med yul du gzhan gyi ngo 'dzin zhing / /dam chos zab mo btsongs nas lto gos sgrub/ /kye hud 'byung pos snying la btab bam ci/ /blun rmongs skye bo khyim du rtse ba ltar/ /blang dor rnam dbye shes pa'i mkhas pa yang / /chos ltar bcos pa'i gzugs brnyan mi 'dor bar/ /tshul chos mi mgo bskor ba'i snying med po/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan rdo rje bla ma la/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan snyan brgyud zab mo nos/ /de don rtse gcig bsgoms na tshe 'di ru/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'grub nges kyang / /da dung gzhan zer snyan dang mi snyan dang / /dgos med tshe 'di'i khe nyen brtsi brtsi nas/ /phyi bshol le lo'i ngang du dus 'da' ba/ /glo snying gting nas rul ba'i rtags ngan yin/ /dam pa'i mgon gyis ma zin blun po rnams/ /tshe 'di 'ba' zhig sgrub las 'os ci yod/ /kho bo dam pa'i snyan brgyud ros tshims nas/ /de don rtse gcig mi sgom the le le/ /ci yang mi shes rmongs pa 'ga' zung dag /lto gos gyong bskur ri phug gnas gyur na/ /bdag cag rgyud don zab mo'i gnad rtogs nas/

/grong yul bzhi mdo nyul ba ngo re gnong / /tshe 'di'i chos brgyad 'ba' zhig don gnyer na/ /lus la ngur smrig gos g.yogs mgo spu bregs/ /dam chos thos bsam byas pa'i dgos pa ci/ /mi nag skye bo las kyang shin tu dman/ /dregs ldan mi dbang stong gi cod paṇa gyis/ /nyin bzhin btud cing bkur bstis mchod pa bas/ /'grogs na bde ba'i ri dwags dag 'grogs na/ /chu dang ldum bu'i mtsho la glo ba dga'/ /rnal 'byor nga ni rje btsun rdo rings pa'i/ /thugs kyi nying khu'i gdams pas snying myos te/ /nam zhig 'di don bsgrub par 'gyur snyam nas/ /yid gnyis bya ba'i skabs gzhan phrogs par 'gyur/ /yid 'ong padmo'i rdzing bur snyeg pa yis/ /shugs drag ngang mo'i rgyu ba su yis bzlog /de bzhin bsam gtan bde bas yid drangs pa'i/ /ku sā li pa sus kyang bzung du med/ /'khor slob sbyin bdag 'khor ba'i rgya ru nges/ /rnyed bkur mchod pa ba tshwa'i rgya mtshor mthong / /dus min snyan grags bdud kyi pho nyar shes/ /dben pa'i nags tshal 'ba' zhig snying nas dran/ /da ni thag ring bas mtha'i sman ljongs ngos/ /nags tshal mthug po phyogs kun rwa bar bris/ /'du 'dzi'i chom rkun sgrib pa'i dka' thub gnas/ /der ni ljon shing rgyas pa'i smin legs ma/ /yid 'ong sngo ljang 'dab ma'i gos kyis bklubs/ /khril shing myu gu'i sor mos dam bcings pas/ /yid 'ong me tog rgyas pa'i 'dzum dkar gyi/ /'bras bu'i dga' ston ci yang 'gyed la brtson/ /padmo ku mud bzhad pa'i do ra na/ /sbrang rtsi'i dog pas kun nas bgos pa yi/ /dri za'i rgyud mang dang mtshungs glu dbyangs kyis/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsi 'gyed pa'i rkang drug lding / /spu sdug gos gyon 'dab ma'i shug sgra can/ /'jo sgeg sgra snyan 'byin pa'i rma bya dang / /tsa ko ra sogs nags kyis mdzes ma rnams/ /phan tshun 'phur lding g.yo bas rtse zhing rgyu/

/chu shel zhu ba 'dra ba'i chu bo'i rgyun/ /mu tig zegs ma 'thor ba'i lbu 'phreng can/ /lhung lhung snyan pa'i sgra sgrog dal gyis 'bab/ /la lar cung zad 'khyil ba'i rdzing bu can/ /khor yug gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /steng phyogs bai ḍūr sngon po'i 'chi med lam/ /chu 'dzin dkar po'i ba dan ci yang brkyang / /bde sogs bdag po'i gzhu ris gur khyim can/ /na bun gsar pa'i cod paṇa rab bcings shing / /nags tshal ljon pa'i sham thabs bcings 'dra ba'i/ /mu tig chu bo'i do shal ring du 'chang / /sa gzhi margad byugs pa lta bu yi/ /ku sha gsar pa'i myu gu bkram pa'i gseb/ /utpal mig can ri dwags pho mo rnams/ /bag phebs dal gyis rgyu zhing dga' bas rtsen/ /mi bsrun skye bo'i 'grul gyis dben gyur zhing / /bya yis rnal 'byor gnyid las slong bar byed/ /nags kyi gar mkhan tshogs rnams rtsed 'jo yi/ /rnal 'byor sems kyi skyo ba bsangs par byed/ /zhen med sngo bsangs yid 'ong chu gtsang gis/ /log pa'i 'tsho ba ming gi mthar byas te/ /lang tsho brtas shing sems ni ston dus kyi/ /zla ba lta bur dwangs shing dri med gyur/ /de lta'i gnas su brag phug zab mo'am/ /dkar 'jam rdo leb brtsigs pa'i khang bu gang / /ljon shing drwa bas bcings pa'i grib bsil la/ /'jam zhing 'bol ba'i rtswa yi gdan stengs su/ /rnam snang 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i 'dug stangs kyis/ /rdo rje'i lus ni g.yo med drang por bcings/ /ca co long gtam smra ba'i rgyun bcad nas/ /mchu sgros g.yo med ri mor bris pa bzhin/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran pas rab bskul nas/ /yud tsam dal bar bsdad pa'i long med par/ /ma rgan 'gro ba kun gyi khur khyer nas/ /bdag ni bla med byang chub 'ba' zhig bsgrub/ /lam gyi snying po zab mo bla ma'i lam/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus kho bo'i bla ma rje/ /'gran zla kun bral rje btsun rdo rings pa/

/gdan gsum tshang ba'i ded dpon he ru ka /bslu med mgon de'i zhabs pad gtsug gis bsten/ /lus srog longs spyod ma lus cig car phul/ /snying dkyil rus pa'i gting nas dad pa yis/ /nyin mtshan khor yug kun tu gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bos sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs te/ /rang sems lhan skyes gdod ma'i bla ma de/ /rang zhal rjen par mthong ba'i dga' ston la/ /'bral med lhug par skyong ba a la la/ /rang ngo rang gis shes pa da lan tsam/ /blo sna nang du khugs pa bla ma'i drin/ /tshe 'di rgyab tu bor ba 'dun ma'i mchog /dge legs rtse mor son pa e ma ho/ /zhes pa 'di ni rgyal khams kyi bya bral 'khyams pos dpal bya bzang bde chen lhun grub kyi ri sul nas gtsang stod kyi dben pa la dga' bas sbyar ba'o// ༈ //na mo gu ra we/ rje bka' drin 'khor med kha'u pa/ /pha kun spangs chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu bsam med kyi blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /chos mtha' ru 'khyongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /phyogs shar gyi tho rangs skar chen la/ /bod so nam pa'i nam tshod kyi blo gtad bcol/ /de bcol yang skar chen je 'gyangs thal/ /khyod skar chen la de las med zer na/ /nged zhing pa la gnyid kyis nam tshod yod/ /skar chen khyod snang ba gang bde la bzhud/ /nub grog rting gi chu mig sngo chung la/ /gzhung gshongs zhing ljang pa'i blo gtad bcol/ /de bcol gyin chu mig je skam thal/ /khyod chu mig la de las med zer na/ /dbyar lho sprin la sbrang char gyis bslus pa med/ /chu mig khyod snang ba gang bde la bzhud/ /khyod chung grogs kyi mang thos rgya mtsho la/ /nga bya bral gyi nang ma'i blo gtad bcol/ /de bcol zhing rgyang skyur byed do lo/ /khyod lugs gnyis kyi phyi thag mi bsam na/ /yongs rgyal khams kyi mi la 'dzad pa med/ /bu ban chung rang snang ba gang bder bzhud/ /de khrel 'debs kyi nyams dbyangs zur tsam yin/

/da snying gtam gyi legs bshad 'di skad smra/ /sems lhan ne gtod la nyams su longs/ /bu bzhin bzang gi ston zla dkar gsal khyod/ /sngar chos min gyis sprin nag khrod du bcings/ /nga'i bden tshig gi snying gtam bser bu 'dis/ /da log rtog gi mun pa kun gsal nas/ /las chos ldan gyi 'od dkar rgyas gyur cig /gnas khams gsum 'khor ba'i mun khrod nas/ /rten dal 'byor yid bzhin bsam 'phel 'di/ /las 'bad med du rnyed pa da lan tsam/ /'di yun ring mi sdod myur du 'jigs/ /bu grung po zhig yin na 'di la soms/ /de bsam bzhin blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /dus sngon tshe mi dge spyad pa'i mthus/ /spyir 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor gtan 'khyams byed/ /dgos ngan song gsum gyi 'gram rdor skyel/ /'di skad cig tsam yang bzod blag med/ /bu grung po zhig yin na 'di la soms/ /de bsam bzhin blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /lus langs tshe ston gyi me tog 'dra/ /'di blo gtad mi thub yal nas 'gro/ /dus deng sang 'dar zhing 'khyoms pa yi/ /khong rgan 'khogs rnams kyi gnas tshul ltos/ /bu grung po zhig yin na 'di la soms/ /de bsam bzhin blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /nor zang zing bung ba'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /de bsags kyang spyod pa'i nges pa med/ /khong phyug po sprang por song ba dang / /khong nor can shi ba'i ro la ltos/ /bu grung po zhig yin na 'di la soms/ /de bsam bzhin blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /sems 'dod yon gyi chags zhen ba tshwa'i chu/ /'di ci tsam spyad kyang sred pa 'phel/ /blo tshim pa'i tha ma yong dus med/ /don de phyir 'dod chung chog shes bsten/ /bu grung po zhig yin na 'di la soms/ /de bsam bzhin blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /grogs bud med bya ba'i blo 'khrid mkhan/ /'dis dang po tshul khrims dang lus stobs 'phrog /bar du ltogs phrug la 'khyongs dus med/ /mthar sdug bsngal gyi ngang nas gtan gyes byed/

/bu grung po zhig yin na 'di la soms/ /de bsam bzhin blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /dug bsam bzhin 'thung ba myos byed chang / /'di 'thungs pas lus la ro mdog chags/ /sems so na yod pa smyon par 'gro/ /chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad stong / /bu grung po zhig yin na 'di la soms/ /de bsam bzhin blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /lus dpung rgyas kyi blo shed byed mkhan de/ /yar bla ma dpon po'i thugs dang 'gal/ /yul skya ser gyi mi kun dgra ru sdang / /nang nor rdzas kun 'thor ba'i chags shing yin/ /bu grung po zhig yin na 'di la soms/ /de bsam bzhin blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /lar tshe 'di yud tsam gcig tu 'dug /dgra 'chi bdag bdud po byung zer na/ /khong mi nor sus kyang phan pa med/ /rang gcig pur 'gro ba'i gnas tshul soms/ /bu grung po zhig yin na 'di la soms/ /de bsam bzhin blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /las byas shing bde ba dam pa'i chos/ /skyabs bslu med bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /nor gsog rin chog pa dge ba'i las/ /grogs 'du 'bral med pa gnyug ma'i sems/ /bu grung po zhig yin na 'di la soms/ /de bsam bzhin blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /don de phyir bu khyod blo sna khug /sems glo snying brang gsum nga la gtod/ /de gtad na bslu med don gnyis 'grub/ /don de la the tshom yod re skan/ /bu chos mgo thon pa'i bkra shis shog /maṅga laṃ/ siddhi ku ru ho// ༈ //swasti/ pha kun spangs chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nga mgrin pa legs bshad bang mdzod nas/ /bu khyod kyis mgon pod bzhengs pa'i yon/ /nyams mgur ma'i glu dbyangs 'di skad smra/ /phyi rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil na/ /nor 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin chen yod/ /de len 'dod kyi tshong phrug mang na yang / /long nges kyi ded dpon re re tsam/ /lho tsan dan 'khrigs pa'i nags khrod na/ /khong rgya stag khra bo dpa' rtsal sbyong /

/de 'dzin 'dod kyi mon pa mang na yang / /zin nges kyi gyad pa re re tsam/ /nub ma pham g.yu mtsho'i gting shed na/ /shing 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu gser du smin/ /de len 'dod kyi dbul po mang na yang / /lon nges kyi skal can re re tsam/ /nga kun spangs chos rje'i bu brgyud la/ /chos zab mo gdams pa'i snyan grags yod/ /de thob 'dod kyis tshab tshub mang na yang / /thob nges kyi snod ldan re re tsam/ /don de rnams shin tu dka' ba las/ /bu khyod kyis thag ring yul nas bsnyegs/ /yul mtha' 'khob 'dir lto gos gyong la bskur/ /nga yid la yod pa lag tu blangs/ /de ngal dub med par dga' spros bsgrubs/ /da snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa yong yong 'dra/ /sems dga' bar byos shig rdo rje'i bu/ /las byas pa don dang ldan par nges/ /lar nga rang tha mal snyoms las can/ /tshe 'di phyi gar 'gro'i gdengs med kyang / /ming la blo gtad byas pa kun/ /pha kun spangs chos rjes mkha' dbyings nas/ /dus rtag tu skyong ba'i zhal bzhes yod/ /don de phyir bya btang sprang po nga / /dkor zas kyi tshogs la longs spyod cing / /bag yangs kyi gcer nyal byed pa lags/ /zhes shar mdo khams kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa mgon po 'od zer gyis dpe cha mang po bzhengs shing / da dung yang bzhengs par khas blangs pa'i yon du springs pa'o/ /ma ma a yu puṇye siddhi ku ru oṃ/ maṅga laṃ// ༈ //na mo gu ra we/ gnas spyi bo bde chen gyi ri bo'i spor/ /rje sku'i rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/ /ma mkha' 'gro so gnyis kyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /sku zla shel gsar pa'i mdangs 'od can/ /pha gsol ba 'debs so rdo rings pa/ /bu mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes skyongs/ /tshogs mchod par 'bul lo drin can rje/ /lus snang stong sprul skur byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi gzhal med na/ /rje gsung gi rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/

/ma mkha' 'gro bcu drug gi 'khor gyis bskor/ /sku padma ra ga'i mdangs 'od can/ /pha gsol ba 'debs so rdo rings pa/ /bu mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes skyongs/ /tshogs mchod par 'bul lo drin can rje/ /ngag brag stong longs skur byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas snying ga chos kyi sman ljongs nas/ /rje thugs kyi rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/ /ma mkha' 'gro zung bzhi'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /sku ind+ra ni la'i mdangs 'od can/ /pha gsol ba 'debs so rdo rings pa/ /bu mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes skyongs/ /tshogs mchod par 'bul lo drin can rje/ /yid rig stong chos skur byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas lte ba sprul pa'i nags khrod na/ /rje yon tan gyi rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/ /ma mkha' 'gro drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor/ /sku 'dzam bu chu bo'i mdangs 'od can/ /bdag yon tan rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas gsang gnas bde skyong gi pho brang du/ /rje 'phrin las rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/ /ma mkha' 'gro so gnyis kyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /sku margad gsar pa'i mdangs 'od can/ /bdag 'phrin las rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /lus snang stong sprul pa'i zhing khams na/ /khams thabs mchog dpa' bo 'dzum dkar bzhad/ /rtsa shes rab dpa' mo bde chen bskyed/ /lus tha mal du snang ba dbyings su yal/ /sems gsal ba gzhon nu'i lang tsho la/ /dbyings stong pa'i dga' mas 'bral med 'khyud/ /yongs zung 'jug gi zlos gar a la la/ /nga brjod bral gyi ltad mo de ring mthong / /pha gsol ba 'debs so rdo rings pa/ /bu mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes skyongs/ /tshogs mchod par 'bul lo drin can rje/ /lus rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas g.yor stod dpal gyi chu bo ri/ /ma ḍā ki 'du ba zhing gi mchog /yul la kha shar gyi dur khrod du/ /nga rnal 'byor dbang phyug blo gsal la/ /kho dad can gyi mkha' 'gros mtha' skor nas/

/zas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'khor bskor/ /nyams rdo rje'i glu dbyangs blangs pa'i tshe/ /nga nyams snang shar ba lhug par smras/ /zhes 'di ni dpal chu bo ri'i dur khrod du zhing skyong gi ḍā ki'i cho 'phrul ngo mtshar ba mthong zhing / dad can nya ma 'gas nyams dbyangs kyis mchod nas/ bdud rtsi'i ril bu rgya ja bzang po'i btung ba dang bcas pa'i tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i tshe sems lhug par bzhag pa'i 'char sgo la ji ltar shar ba'i yi ge bkod pa a ho mahā su kha ho// ༈ //swa sti/ rje yongs grags kyi rdo rings kun spangs pa/ /mi nga rang gi dus gsum sangs rgyas dngos/ /mtshan dran pas gdung sel kha'u pa/ /mkha' mi mngon gyi dbyings nas thugs rjes skyongs/ /dpal cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong nas/ /rje bla ma'i dbon sras chos kyi rje/ /thugs dag snang gi gsung phrin rdo rje'i glu/ /sprang bya btang gi 'dun sar dal gyis phebs/ /nga dkor zan gyi bandhe rdul phran tsam/ /khyod yon tan gyi lhun po yin no skad/ /khyed gzur gnas kyi gsung la zol zog med/ /de sngon med kyi brag cha'i gtam snyan yin/ /gsung rdo rje'i khengs pa'i yid kyi mtshor/ /sems dga' spro dang rlom pa'i rba rlabs 'khrigs/ /de brtags tshe brjod bral chu bo'i ngang / spros med kyi rang gdangs a la la/ /lar dal 'byor mi lus thob pa dkon/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma mjal ba nyung / /chos zab mo thob pa brgya lam tsam/ /sems rang ngo shes pa nyin skar tsam/ /don de phyogs med ri sul ljongs/ /sems zhen med du rgyu ba'i bya btang dbang / /khyed gtad med kyi nyams rtogs skyong ba la/ /sprang zol med kyi dag snang ci yang skye/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma byin rlabs che/ /lam gsang chen gyi nyams len zab khyad che/ /khyod sngon goms kyi bag chags ngo mtshar che/ /tshe 'di snang gi snying rus zhen bcad tshe/ /lha mi bskyod rdo rje'i pho brang na/

/dpal zhe sdang rdo rje'i rang zhal mjal/ /de ser sna rdo rjes mjal sna byas/ /khams dwangs snyigs 'dres pa'i tshogs 'khor bskor/ /rlung reg bya can gyi rol rtsed las/ /nyams lus sems kyi bde sdug cir yang shar/ /de rang ngo shes pa'i gdengs yod na/ /tshe 'di phyi don chen 'grub nas gda'/ /khong bos pa'i mgron chen bslebs nas 'dug /da brjod med kyi ngang du bskyur las zhog /a la la ri khrod sgom chen pa/ /snying gtam 'di sbos la rgyang glu longs/ /gzhi 'khrul snang gi rang zhal bltas tsa na/ /brjod med kyi dbyings su rjen rjen pa/ /gser gling du bol dum ngas ma rnyed/ /ma sems can tsho rang mgo ga la 'khor/ /lam bskyed rdzogs gnad du bsnun tsa na/ /cir snang 'di nyams kyi ban ma bun/ /snang grags rig gsum 'di rgyal ba'i ngang / /khong rnal 'byor tsho blang dor gang la byed/ /lam bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu sgra bo che/ /gzhi mngon du gyur pa'i skad du gda'/ /'di rang chas su yod par rang ngo shes/ /da 'bras bu bya ba gzhan ma mchis/ /sems las med du nyal ba'i rang ngo na/ /lam zab mo dbang bzhi'i chu bo'i rgyun/ /dus mnyam rjes 'khor mor ma mchis sam/ /'di brjod med du skyong ba bla ma'i drin/ /rje gsang chen ston pa'i bla ma de/ /lha dus gsum sangs rgyas kun las lhag /drin bsam bzhin bka' drin 'khor thabs med/ /sems dag pa'i dbyings su 'bral med mjal/ /ri gangs rdul 'khrigs pa'i stong yangs na/ /khong gcan gzan rgyal po gdong lnga pa/ /sems dgos med kyi dpa' rtsal ci yang sbyongs/ /'di gangs stod du 'gying ba dpa' rtags che/ /de ci rkyang rgyal po'i sgo bsrungs na/ /rang tshugs kyi 'gying bag ma shor zhing / /khong yangs la phyi nang phyed pa dgos/ /ci byas kun gzhan don myur na bde/ /'phags yul gyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang / /sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma'i tshogs/ /ci snang kun nyams su ngo sprad pas/

/yon tan dang dngos grub kho na las/ /bar chad dang skyon du 'dzin srol med/ /rang ngo la bltas pa'i rang dag de/ /rang yan du bskyangs pas rang grol yin/ /byung rgyal du skyong ba de la zer/ /de shes na bde skyid kyi ngang du gnas/ /gnad med kyi bla ma gong tshas yin/ /tha snyad kyi tshig nyog nga rgyal rgyu/ /ci med kyi sprang po nga rgyang glu 'tsher/ /drin can bla ma de sku drin che/ /khyed nyams rtogs kyi pad dkar bzhad pa dang / /nga dag snang gi nyi gzhon rgyas pa gnyis/ /dpal thub bstan gyi ldum rar zhal mjal zhus/ /chos legs tshogs rten 'brel dbyings su 'grig /dus da nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /sems log rtog gi rnyog mas ma slad par/ /lus snang stong gi 'dzum dkar ston bzhin du/ /ma sems can kun sgrol ba'i 'gros 'dun bgyid/ /a dkor zas kyi rgya mtsho mer ba nas/ /dha gtad med kyi sprang po de skad lo/ /dpal cha lung gi ri khrod sgom chen pa/ /khyed sa skya pa'i bla chen dges par smon/ /dge legs// ༈ //na mo gu ra we/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo ni/ /sku'i bla ma rnam snang mdzad/ /dkar gsal 'dzum dang ldan pa bzhugs/ /'gyur med lhun grub gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /lus la sku'i byin gyis rlobs/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo ni/ /gsung gi bla ma 'od dpag med/ /dmar gsal 'dzum dang ldan pa bzhugs/ /'gag med bde chen gsol ba 'debs/ /yan lag drug cu ldan pa yis/ /ngag la gsung gi byin gyis rlobs/ /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /thugs kyi bla ma mi bskyod pa/ /sngo gsal 'dzum dang ldan pa bzhugs/ /'khrul med mnyam nyid gsol ba 'debs/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa yis/ /yid la thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /yon tan bla ma rin chen 'byung / /ser mdog 'dzum bag ldan pa bzhugs/ /yang dag dran par gsol ba 'debs/

/brgyud la yon tan rin po che/ /zad mi shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo ni/ /'phrin las bla ma don yod grub/ /ljang gsal 'dzum bag ldan pa bzhugs/ /gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /dngos grub rnam bzhi ldan pa yis/ /phrin las bzhi yis byin gyis rlobs/ /chos dbyings 'gyur med 'khor lo ni/ /rang rig bde chen bla ma rje/ /cir snang chos sku'i mdangs ldan bzhugs/ /byar med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis med ngang las ma g.yos par/ /mnyam nyid ngang du byin gyis rlobs// ༈ //swasti/ snang stong 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lha sku bsgoms/ /grags stong brag cha lta bu'i gsang sngags bzlos/ /gsal stong 'dzin med ngang du glod la zhog /dmigs pa'i snying po dril ba 'di lta ste/ /snying ga'i hūm̐ gi tha mar snying po'i phreng / /kha dog sngon po g.yas bskor 'khod pa la/ /yig 'bru re nas klog pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sgrim glod ran pa'i sems kyis lta zhing 'don/ /res 'ga' sngags 'bru re la me dpung ni/ /'ur 'ur 'bar bar bsam zhing gsang sngags thon/ /res 'ga' rang nyid nag po chen po'i skur/ /lam me yin snyam nga rgyal ngang nas 'don/ /res 'ga' sngags kyi rang sgra grags stong la/ /rtse gcig sems gtad de ga'i ngang nas 'don/ /spros bcas dmigs pa de dag mi gsal na/ /spros med ci yang yid la mi sems par/ /had de chod de'i ngang la gsang sngags 'don/ /'di dag gcig la sun na gcig la spo/ /go rim nges med yid yul gang bde yin/ /gal te rig pa bying zhing 'thibs pa na/ /gos srab zas dbri lus gnad drang por bsrang / /mig gi lta stangs smin mtshams thad du blta/ /sngags kyi nga ro 'brug ltar drag tu bzla/ /rig pa rgod cing 'thor ba'i skyon byung na/ /mig gi lta stangs sna rtse tsam du blta/ /bcud ldan zas bza' gsang sngags shib bur bzla/ /cha mnyam lus sems glod la bde cha rtsal/
